research_item_leads.title: Drinking- and wastewater The Dutch drinking water supply is among the best in the world. The WAC contributes to solutions for future challenges. Water research
Energy The energy sector is looking for alternative ways of energy production, using water as a fuel or waste product. Energy & water
Process water The WAC has research facilities to find the best method for cleaning wastewater for each (textile) company. Process water
Soil and water No water, no agriculture. Therefore, a good water level and a balanced water supply are vital. Soil & water
SOILCRATES Healthy soil is the foundation of our food system, a prerequisite for clean water, important for biodiversity and contributes to resilience in times of climate change.

Area-based water approach for milk and climate Climate change is making the sandy regions in East Friesland increasingly vulnerable to drought. We are working with farmers, water authorities and local collectives on an area-based approach to improve water retention and thereby reduce drought damage.

Diadema II project Research project aimed at restoring the important herbivorous sea urchin Diadema antillarum on Caribbean coral reefs Coastal & Marine Systems Adapting to climate change Enhancing sustainable water management Water & Nature Climate & Environment
Artificial cow model An artificial alternative to animal testing. Sustainable Dairy and Food Processing
Climate Smart Dairy Farming A field lab for a sustainable future in dairy production.
Libjende Landbou Less dependence on chemicals and labour, more space for and connection with ecology.
MicroMilk In this project, we are conducting pioneering research on the relationship between the soil microbiome, nutrients in grassland, and the milk composition of dairy farmers in Friesland.
Soils2Guts Steering soil microbiomes for better crop quality - the holy grail to improve human health

Living Lab 'Sustainable Business Succession Development of the serious game Around the Table, about sustainable business succession in the agricultural sector. Climate Smart Dairy Value Chains Making agriculture and food chains sustainable Food & Agribusiness

Sods for the (Green) Dike Research into whether dredging sludge is suitable for developing green, strong and biodiverse dike revetment. Nature Based River Management Adapting to climate change Enhancing sustainable water management Water & Nature Climate & Environment Dutch

Klarendal neighbourhood green agenda In the Arnhem neighbourhood of Klarendal, students from Management of the Living Environment are drawing up a neighbourhood green agenda in consultation with residents. Developing a sustainable living environment Climate & Environment Dutch

Fishing For Connection Fish for Connection is an ecological-economic project to improve water quality and fish ecology as well as to boost the sport fishing economy. Coastal & Marine Systems Adapting to climate change Enhancing sustainable water management Water & Nature Climate & Environment Dutch
Waste Market The aim of the project is to develop at least eight new products based on partners' residual streams.

Súd Ie Gaining knowledge on the accessibility of Súd Ie for eels and three-spined sticklebacks. For advice on sustainable management and utilisation of these areas. Coastal & Marine Systems Adapting to climate change Enhancing sustainable water management Water & Nature Climate & Environment Dutch

Climate-robust water management for Frisian sandy areas This project will develop a more robust water management design for sandy soils in eastern Fryslân that will make both agriculture and nature more climate-resilient.

Climate-adaptive green management Management of existing green can greatly contribute to climate adaptation objectives of governments. Adapting to climate change Developing a sustainable living environment Climate & Environment Dutch
